scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir backend lint
scripts.format: pnpm --dir frontend format && pnpm --dir backend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend format:check && pnpm --dir backend format:check
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.check:types: pnpm --dir frontend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir backend exec prisma generate && pnpm --dir backend exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:types && pnpm test
